entries.title: Isaiah 65:1
segments: ¶I am sought of [them that] asked not [for me]; I am found of [them that] sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation [that] was not called by my name.

words.text: , Behold me, behold me, unto a nation

entries.title: Isaiah 65:2
segments: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way [that was] not good, after their own thoughts;

entries.title: Isaiah 65:3
segments: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick; {upon...: Heb. upon bricks}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:4
segments: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable [things is in] their vessels; {broth: or, pieces}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:5
segments: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These [are] a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day. {nose: or, anger}

words.text: to me; for I am holier

entries.title: Isaiah 65:6
segments: Behold, [it is] written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

words.text: me: I will not keep silence

entries.title: Isaiah 65:7
segments: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:8
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and [one] saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing [is] in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

words.text: [is] in it: so will I do
' sakes, that I may not destroy

entries.title: Isaiah 65:9
segments: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:10
segments: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:11
segments: ¶But ye [are] they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number. {troop: or, Gad} {number: or, Meni, a pagan god}

words.text: . {troop: or, Gad} {number: or, Meni, a pagan god}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:12
segments: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose [that] wherein I delighted not.

words.text: , and ye shall all bow down

entries.title: Isaiah 65:13
segments: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

entries.title: Isaiah 65:14
segments: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit. {vexation: Heb. breaking}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:15
segments: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

entries.title: Isaiah 65:16
segments: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:17
segments: ¶For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind. {come...: Heb. come upon the heart}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:18
segments: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever [in that] which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:19
segments: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:20
segments: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner [being] an hundred years old shall be accursed.

words.text: There shall be no more thence an infant

entries.title: Isaiah 65:21
segments: And they shall build houses, and inhabit [them]; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:22
segments: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree [are] the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands. {shall long...: Heb. shall make them continue long, or, shall wear out}

words.text: . {shall long...: Heb. shall make them continue long, or, shall wear out}

entries.title: Isaiah 65:23
segments: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they [are] the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.

entries.title: Isaiah 65:24
segments: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, that before they call
; and while they are yet speaking

entries.title: Isaiah 65:25
segments: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust [shall be] the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
